site.audience: developers, engineering teams, and technical decision-makers

brief.title: DeployCloud Blog — Discover the latest in web development
brief.one_liner: A tech blog showcasing engineering insights, product updates, and community stories from a cloud deployment platform.
brief.goal: Provide a content hub for developers to discover articles about cloud infrastructure, AI agents, developer tools, and platform updates, driving engagement and product awareness.

pages.objective: Serve as the main blog landing page, showcasing featured articles and a chronological feed of latest posts with category filtering.

interactions.trigger: Click on a category pill button (e.g., Engineering, Community, Company News, Customers, etc.)
interactions.expected: The active category pill is highlighted and the blog post list filters to show only posts from that category

interactions.trigger: Click on the search input field and type a keyword
interactions.expected: Posts are filtered based on the search query; a 'no results' message appears if no matches are found

interactions.trigger: Click the 'Show more posts' button at the bottom of the latest news grid
interactions.expected: Additional blog post cards are loaded and appended to the grid

interactions.trigger: Click or hover on the 'Products' navigation dropdown in the header
interactions.expected: A mega menu dropdown expands showing product categories like AI Cloud, Core Platform, Security

interactions.trigger: Click or hover on the 'Resources' navigation dropdown in the header
interactions.expected: A dropdown menu expands showing links to Company, Learn, Open Source sections

expected_content: A new programming model for durable execution
data_display.description: Three featured article cards displayed prominently at the top of the blog, each with a date, title, excerpt, and author avatar
